title: Logarithmic geometry and Infinitesimal Hodge Theory
summary: This paper develops a systematic approach to infinitesimal variations of Hodge structure for singular and equisingular families by means of logarithmic geometry and residue theory. The central idea is that logarithmic vector fields encode precisely those deformation directions that preserve singularities and act trivially on Hodge structures, while the effective variation is entirely governed by residue calculus.
